course.title: Site and Area Planning

content.value: Monolova Properties Ltd. wants to develop a residential housing project near (15) Khulna City. The area is of 150 acres. Calculate the following facilities taking 350 person / acre as gross density for that housing project based on the Private Residential Housing Project Land Development Rules 2012. (i) Total population of the project area (ii) Primary School (iii) College (iv) CBD

_source_title: B.Sc. Engineering 2nd Year 1st Term Regular Examination, 2018
